fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix (SKHY) is recommended as a memory stock to outperform Micron and Sandisk, with Q3 2026 revenue recording $7.9 billion, a 328% year-over-year increase.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix holds a 29% DRAM market share (industry 2nd place) and 19% NAND flash share (ahead of Micron and Sandisk), with HBM4 chip revenue expected to exceed HBM3E.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK Hynix has pre-sold over half of its production capacity for 2027–2028 through long-term contracts with 14 customers, with memory demand projected to exceed supply through 2030.
